summary: ASX 200 -1.03% to 8,819 — worst session since June, ~$32bn wiped, third straight fall, as Brent topped US$101 and the US 10yr neared 5%. Every one of 11 sectors red. SBM +16.44% on the Simberi sale led a defensive gold bid; BHP/RIO fell despite record copper. Smart Money rotated hard into utilities, energy and REITs.
